normalizedResponse.reasoning: Cutting spot emissions by 22% reduces daily farm sell pressure from 410k to ~287k tokens (30-day supply shock ~4.1% vs 7% cap). Redirecting half the saved emissions to locked LP gauges deepens sticky liquidity; modeled LP depth rises from $24mm to $28.6mm after 30 days, crossing the $28mm threshold that unlocks $72k/day borrow fee value ($2.16mm over 30 days, risk-adjusted to ~$1.84mm expected). The team unlock delay avoids a 14mm token overhang and 1.8mm bribe inflation. Treasury buyback is inferior because it is conditional and does not structurally reduce sell pressure. Hedge: short 30-day perpetuals at $3.2mm notional offsets residual spot delta from the desk's token holdings and reflexive price risk if LP depth undershoots.
